[Pre-Verse]
[G]

[Verse 1]
[G]Livin on the road
my friend ,
[D]is gonna keep you free
and clean
[C]And now you wear your skin
like iron
[G]And your breath as hard as
[D]kerosene
[C]Weren't your momma's on-
ly boy, but her
[G]favorite one it seemed
[C]
[Em]She began to cry
[C]when you said [G/B]
[D]goodbye

[Pre-Chorus]
[C]And sank into your
[Em]dreams
[D/F#]

[Verse 2]
[G]Pancho was a ban-
dit boy,
[D]his horse was fast as po-
lished steel
[C]He wore his gun outside
his pants
[G]For all the honest world
[D]to feel
[C]Pancho met his match,
you know, on the
[G]deserts down in Me-
[C]xico
[Em]Nobody heard his dy-
[C]in [G/B]words,
[D]

[Pre-Chorus]
[C]ah but that's the way it
[Em]goes
[D/F#]

[Chorus]
[C]All the Federa-
les say,
[G]they could've had him a-
[C]ny day
[Em]They only let him slip
[G/B][C]a-
[D]way,
out of
[C]kindness, I suppose
[Em]

[Verse 3]
[G]Lefty, he can't sing
the blues
[D]all night long like he
used to
[C]The dust that Pancho bit
down south
[G]ended up in Lef-
[D]ty's mouth
[C]The day they laid poor
Pancho low,
[G]Lefty split for O-
[C]hio
[Em]Where he got the bread
[C]to [G/B]
[D]go,

[Pre-Chorus]
[C]there ain't nobody knows
[Em]
[D/F#]

[Chorus]
[C]All the Federa-
les say,
[G]they could've had him a-
[C]ny day
[Em]They only let him slip
[G/B][C]a-
[D]way,
out of

[C]
[G]
[C]
[G]

[Verse 4]
[G]The poets tell how old
Pancho fell,
[D]and Lefty's livin in
cheap hotels
[C]The desert's quiet, Cleve-
land's cold
[G]And so the story ends,
[D]we're told
[C]Pancho needs your prayers
it's true,
[G]but save a few for
[C]Lefty too
[Em]He only did what he
[C]had [G/B]to
[D]do,

[Pre-Chorus]
[C]and now he's growing
[Em]old
[D/F#]

[Chorus]
[C]All the Federa-
les say,

[C]so [G/B]
[D]long,
out of
[C]kindness I suppose
[Em]

[Outro]
[C]A few gray Federa-
les say,
[G]they could've had him a-
[C]ny day
[Em]They only let him go
[C]so [G/B]
[D]long,
out of
[C]kindness I suppose

title: Pancho And Lefty
